tex_content.html:
Definition
[$\kappa $-non-collapsed Riemannian manifold] ↗ def:kappa-noncollapsed

A complete $n$-manifold $(M,g)$ is $\kappa $-non-collapsed if, for every $p\in M$ and $r>0$, the bound $|\Rm _g|\leq r^{-2}$ on $B(p,r)$ implies $\Vol B(p,r)\geq \kappa r^n$.

Theorem
[Classification of gradient shrinking solitons in dimension 2 and 3]
